edges_list.rationale: The candidate will develop new features and maintain existing code using Python and Flask.
The candidate will develop frontend applications with JavaScript and React.

The candidate will develop frontend applications using JavaScript and Bootstrap.
Elasticsearch can be used in conjunction with PostgreSQL for data analysis and search capabilities.
Redis and Kafka are both caching and messaging systems that can be used together in a full-stack environment.

Linux is a key part of the job requirements in an agile environment.
The permis B certificate validates that the candidate has the skills required for a full-stack developer role.
